description: Archive a category that nothing uses — typically a starter category your user does not need. Refused, and nothing written, while anything still uses it: items (drafts too), sub-categories, item models, fields defined on it, a maintenance plan that selects it, or an item kit that lists it — the answer names what. An archived category leaves every list and picker and the app cannot bring it back: name it to your user and get their OK first. Requires the manager role.
name: archive_category

alreadyArchived.description: It was archived before this call

archived.description: True = archived; false = refused, nothing written

inUse.description: On a refusal, what still uses it: items, drafts, subCategories, models, fields, maintenancePlans, kits (counts)

instruction.description: What to tell your user on a refusal

readLimitReached.description: Areas this check could not read in full — refused for safety, nothing written
